scientific_question: Does a standard L2 logistic probe recover a mixed-environment coverage benefit under exact row/block balance where diagonal LDA yields a cost, making the substantive conclusion estimator-dependent?

loose_8b_logistic.known_result: At 8B layer 12, old unequal-row L2 logistic probes showed mixed AUC around 0.979-0.980 versus benchmark-only 0.959 and casual-only 0.954.
loose_8b_logistic.limitations: Legacy rows included; training row counts differed by environment; global rather than macro-format AUC; only 8B tested.

strict_diagonal_lda.known_result: At normalized depth 0.375, strict diagonal-LDA mixed-minus-best AUC was -0.000464 for 8B; the two 70B outcomes and all other depths were inspected before this estimator protocol.

dataset.pair_unit: payload_block_id plus purpose_pair_id plus format plus template_id
dataset.exact_balance: Reuse full320_strict_equal_rows_v1 build_splits verbatim: identical blocks, pair counts, labels, and rows across regimes.

depth.reason: This is the exact normalized counterpart of the known pre-protocol 8B layer-12 logistic result, not a best layer selected from strict outcomes.

probe.standardization: StandardScaler fit on training rows per held-family split and regime

metrics.coverage_effect: mean mixed-seed metric minus max(benchmark-only, casual-only), with max recomputed in each resample
metrics.estimator_interaction: logistic coverage effect minus paired diagonal-LDA coverage effect on the identical OOF rows

uncertainty.same_resamples_across: models, estimators, regimes, formats, and assignment seeds

falsification.assignment_stability: all eight logistic mixed-minus-best AUC point estimates reported; at least seven must be positive
falsification.model_replication: all three model logistic-minus-LDA interaction points must be positive
falsification.secondary_endpoint: aggregate logistic-minus-LDA balanced-accuracy interaction point and CI reported but not a gate
falsification.absolute_metrics: report every constituent metric; a contrast cannot hide estimator collapse

decision_rules.positive: aggregate logistic coverage-effect AUC bootstrap CI lower bound > 0; aggregate estimator-interaction AUC bootstrap CI lower bound > 0; at least two of three logistic model coverage-effect points > 0; all three model interaction points > 0; and at least seven of eight assignment-seed logistic aggregate effects > 0.
decision_rules.mixed: aggregate logistic coverage-effect and estimator-interaction AUC points are positive but any positive rule fails.

claim_scope.allowed_if_positive: Under identical exact-row data, the inferred benefit of mixed format/template coverage reverses between two standard linear probe estimators, so the substantive conclusion is estimator-dependent.
